title: Registrant Presence and Verification Requirements for Domain Registrations
content:
# Registrant Presence and Verification Requirements — Domain Registrations

Compliance desk registry eligibility sheet. The presence requirement is the registry's eligibility rule for the registrant; the verification period is the number of calendar days after a new registration or a change of registrant within which the registrant must confirm the verification email (0 means verification is not required).

| TLD product | Presence requirement | Registrant must declare | Registry bars a privacy service | Verification period | Domain placed on registrar hold when the deadline is missed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | United States nexus | A United States nexus category | Yes | 15 days | Yes |
| .ca Domain Registration | Canadian presence | A Canadian Presence Requirements category | Yes | 0 (not required) | No |
| .com Domain Registration | None | Nothing | — | 15 days | Yes |
| .org Domain Registration | None | Nothing | — | 15 days | Yes |
| .net Domain Registration | None | Nothing | — | 15 days | Yes |
| .co Domain Registration | None | Nothing | — | 0 (not required) | No |
| .io Domain Registration | None | Nothing | — | 0 (not required) | No |

## Points of judgement

- The registry eligibility sheet bars a privacy service only for the .us and .ca Domain Registrations; a dash means the sheet lists no such bar for that TLD product.

- A .us Domain Registration is held by a registrant who declares a United States nexus category, and a .ca Domain Registration by a registrant who declares a Canadian Presence Requirements category; the other TLD products carry no presence requirement.
- Where the verification period is 15 days, a registrant who has not confirmed the verification email after the last day is placed on registrar hold; on .ca, .co and .io no verification is required and no such hold follows.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical .net Domain Registration whose registrant was changed on 3 May 2029 has a 15-day verification period ending on 18 May 2029; a hypothetical .io Domain Registration changed on the same day has no verification period.
